profile_text.body:
Apple is a public company founded in 1976 and headquartered in Cupertino, CA, that designs and sells consumer hardware, software, and services. Its website for AI focuses on Apple Intelligence and a next-generation version of Siri, which the company describes as "truly helpful AI that's centered around you and your needs," integrated into iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS Golden Gate, watchOS 27, and visionOS 27. The company describes these features as coming later this year, with Siri AI initially available in English and noted as not initially available in the EU on iOS, iPadOS, and watchOS.

Apple Intelligence is the company's on-device AI system, built around Apple silicon and a Private Cloud Compute architecture that the company positions as privacy-first with minimal data exposure. The next-generation Siri, powered by Apple Intelligence, is described as capable of natural back-and-forth conversation, taking actions across apps such as Messages, Music, and Reminders, generating and editing written drafts, automating tasks via Shortcuts, and answering questions by referencing information online. Apple also tracks AI capabilities in Final Cut Pro and iMovie, both described as on-device, Apple silicon-optimized tools for video editing.

Held facts show Apple is a publicly traded company on the AAPL ticker with a CIK of 0000320193 and reported revenue of $416,161,000,000 for the period ending September 27, 2025, per a 10-K filing. Two MCP servers are associated with the company in the registry: one for managing Apple Ads campaigns and reporting, and one providing Apple Developer Documentation with semantic search, retrieval-augmented generation, and AI reranking. No litigation is recorded in the held facts.
